subject: a tall stack of three thick, hearty whole-grain flaxseed pancakes with a darker, rustic crumb, topped with a dollop of Greek yogurt, banana slices, blueberries, chopped walnuts, a pinch of whole flaxseeds and a thin drizzle of honey
hero_ko: 통곡물 아마씨 반죽(짙은 크럼) + 그릭요거트 + 바나나 + 블루베리 + 호두 + 통아마씨 + 꿀

geometry.silhouette: 3단 두툼 스택(약 2.5cm/장), 돔 윗면, 부푼 둥근 가장자리, 손으로 놓은 오프셋, 높이≈폭의 60%, 프레임 폭 65% 점유. 토핑은 전부 윗면에 얹힘(반죽에 박지 않음).
geometry.body: Three thick, tender pancakes stacked with a small, casual offset, as if placed by hand rather than aligned by a machine — the middle one shifted a little to the right, the top one a little back. Each pancake is a plump, pillowy round about 2.5 cm thick with a gently domed top and a soft rounded edge that bulges slightly outward where the batter rose in the pan; the stack is about 60% as tall as it is wide and occupies roughly 65% of the frame width, leaving generous empty background around it. The batter is whole-grain with ground flaxseed, so the pancakes read darker and heartier than a plain stack: the side wall of each one is a warm oat-brown crumb (#D2AE7A) with a coarser open texture and a faint, even fleck of bran and ground flax throughout — no visible seeds, just a nutty, slightly speckled grain — and the top face is griddle-browned in a soft blotchy gradient from deep nutty brown (#8F5F33) at the centre to warm tan (#B98A55) at the rim, with a matte, slightly rougher surface than a white-flour pancake. A few tiny pinprick pores sit near the rim of the top pancake, barely visible. Where the pancakes touch, the top one presses very slightly into the one below, so the edges kiss softly instead of floating. The whole stack looks warm, tender and freshly flipped — the honest irregularity of a handmade bake.

toppings.label: GREEK YOGURT
toppings.text: One generous dollop of thick Greek yogurt (#FBF6EC), spooned rather than piped, sits slightly off-centre toward the front-left of the top pancake: a dense, matte, softly peaked mound with a spoon-mark on one side, its lower edge settling into a soft skirt against the warm pancake — the clean white is the brightest thing on the plate against the brown crumb.

toppings.label: FRUIT
toppings.text: Three slices of banana about 7 mm thick, cut a little unevenly, leaning in an overlapping row against the yogurt — pale creamy yellow (#F1E3A6) flesh with small dark seed-dots at the centre and a faint moist sheen. About seven blueberries (#3E4A73) with a dusty grey-blue bloom, each a slightly different size, in a loose cluster spilling from the yogurt onto the browned pancake, one alone near the rim.

toppings.label: NUTS, FLAXSEEDS AND HONEY
toppings.text: A small handful of toasted walnuts (#A9784A), coarsely chopped into pieces of clearly different sizes with their ridged surfaces showing, sprinkled over the yogurt and fruit. A pinch of whole flaxseeds — a mix of glossy brown (#5A3A1E) and golden (#C89A4A) seeds, each a tiny flat teardrop — sprinkled over the top of the yogurt where they show clearly against the white, a few sliding down its side. A thin drizzle of clear golden honey (#D9A441), translucent and glossy, traced once over everything and spilling over the front edge into two slow drips of different lengths down the side walls.

toppings.label: FINISHING
toppings.text: A very light dusting of ground cinnamon over the near rim. One small sprig of fresh mint with two leaves (#3E7A45) tucked against the yogurt. The toppings gather toward the front-left so the browned pancake surface stays visible on the opposite side, and the composition reads as one deliberate, appetizing arrangement — realistic portion size, no duplicate identical elements.

Soft studio softbox key light from the upper left with gentle warm ambient fill, a subtle rim of light along the top edges of the stack, and a faint, soft contact shadow directly beneath the stack only. Appetizing food-photography color grading: warm, fresh, clean whites, saturated but natural colours, no colour cast on the background.
